intro: Destruction in Deadmines is a clandestine mission overseen by Alba Fairmoon in Westfall. With the explosives planted beside the Defias forge deep in the Deadmines, the operative rejoins Alba in the hills behind Moonbrook and triggers the detonator from a safe distance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We are almost finished. Use the detonator, and end this.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I don't know what to say, friend. To think that Stormwind would put their military ambitions over the livelihood of their people...
